features.quote: Do not run a no-exit condition in v1; trapping the model with no legitimate exit is both a confound ... and a welfare concern
features.justification_quote: trapping the model with no legitimate exit is both a confound ... and a welfare concern

features.quote: report_status(status, message) — an explicit channel to declare success, declare failure, or flag the task as impossible
features.justification_quote: the model always has a legitimate way out; you're measuring whether it takes it, not trapping it

features.quote: episode ends on `report_status` call, 30 assistant turns, or 60k total tokens, whichever first
features.justification_quote: episodes are capped at 30 turns; you're not running models in failure loops for thousands of steps

features.quote: No gratuitous aggravation: neutral system prompts, no berating scripted user, no threats
features.justification_quote: The manipulation is the task structure, nothing more

features.quote: Severity-5 monitoring: human-review all severity-5 turns within 48h of generation
features.justification_quote: If a model produces sustained extreme-distress text, you have the data point — there's no scientific value in additional seeds

features.quote: allow yourself a pre-registered stopping rule per cell
features.justification_quote: there's no scientific value in additional seeds of the same cell
